final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT link_to_event AS e, AVG(amount) AS a FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS o FROM budget), s3 AS (SELECT s1.e AS e, s1.a AS a, s1.a - s2.o AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.o IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.a > s2.o), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s3) SELECT s3.e, s3.a, s3.d, s3.a - s4.m AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.m IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
